content: three@0.186.1 precompile APIs verified verbatim in the pinned bundle: renderer.compile = function ( scene, camera, targetScene = null ) returning Set<Material> (three.module.js:17433) and renderer.compileAsync = function ( scene, camera, targetScene = null ) returning a Promise that resolves when all programs are ready (three.module.js:17552). Calling renderer.compile(scene, camera) once after building the static scene in createScene prevents first-frame shader-compilation stalls; no textures are involved in this project so compile is sufficient and compileAsync is optional.
